title: Chapter 36 Attitude
content:
Chapter 36 Attitude

"Take, thorn, tuck, thorn, raise your hands a little higher for me, and continue to be straight and tidy."

"Turn to the right, follow my orders, walk to the right in unison, be tidy, and don't fall behind."

Following the reprimands, all the recruits gradually became proficient in the army's battle formations under the shouts of the instructors.

Gradually, he took on the appearance of a recruit, his spirit and appearance were all invigorated, and he also looked quite mighty and extraordinary, with such a wave of morale.

Standing on the commander's high platform, Zhong Yu, accompanied by several generals, constantly inspected the training progress of these soldiers, nodding his head. for satisfaction.

Around him are some team leaders who manage 50 people, or generals who manage 100 people. At this time, everyone surrounded him, constantly telling him about the progress of the army training these days.

As well as some things that happened in the military camp, they did not dare to decide, so they could only report it to Zhong Yu, and let the lord decide these things.

Listening to the constant reports of those generals, I dealt with some trivial matters a little. In your mind, you have a quick impression of the training situation of these recruits in your mind. Gradually there was some low in my heart.

Turning his head, he asked a hundred generals around him:

"Then tell me, it will take a few days for this batch of recruits to barely reach the point of dispatching troops, and I don't ask them to be able to go to the battlefield immediately, I only ask them to wave the flag for me, watch over some barbarian prisoners, and You can also train while walking on the marching road.”

Hearing Zhong Yu's question, the general, who had an excited expression on his face, suddenly became condensed, his face became stiff, and his voice gradually became low, and gradually became silent.

The other generals, who were originally envious of him being able to get the Lord's questioning, are now extremely fortunate in their hearts, and some people couldn't help showing sarcasm on their faces. You are proud, now the retribution will come soon!

Why are these people like this? But it was because these recruits were only trained for a week or seven days.

However, to be able to understand some orders a little, and to be able to proficiently carry out marching and basic war training, at least one week is left for him, that is, half a month in total is barely enough time.

Now it's only half of his training, but the Lord asks this question, how can he answer it?

Saying no, is this showing your incompetence to the lord? Yes, when the time comes, these recruits are really pulled to the battlefield by the lord, and if there is a mistake, then I really can't atone for their sins.

Just when the general was entangled in his heart, and his face gradually turned pale, he suddenly saw the impatient look on Zhong Yu's face, and his heart was even more stubborn, and he couldn't take much care of it anymore, and quickly replied:

"Reporting to my lord, the last commander will not dare to lie. These recruits have only been trained for only seven days. They are not very skilled in various tactics and battle formations, and they are not very proficient in the orders of generals. If they want to be reluctantly drawn to the battlefield, it will take at least seven days, which is enough for half a month. Only by teaching it can you be able to use it!"

That general finally didn't dare to lie. In his heart, if he answered truthfully, at most one would be demoted.

And if you deceive the Lord for the lord's momentary appreciation and joy, and let the Lord find out that he has even made a mistake on the battlefield, then he can do it, he will die, and even his family will be implicated, and the whole family will be regarded as slaves.

Seeing the general's answer, Zhong Yu had a smile on his face, and the haze on his face gradually dissipated. How does he know that these recruits are not available? In this case, I will test the loyalty of those generals to me.

When I found out about this general, I really didn't dare to deceive myself, and my heart was filled with gratification. As a superior, I am not afraid of the incompetence of my subordinates, and I am not even afraid that my subordinates are full of ill-conceived ambitions, as long as they can use them for their own use, and earnestly fulfill every command of their own.

Be meticulous, have no flaws, let others at least say nothing on the face, then you can endure everything.

But the most fearful thing is that for their own temporary interests, their subordinates choose to deceive their superiors, in order to harm the interests of the superiors, to achieve their goals. This is the most feared thing for all superiors.

All subordinates who dare to do so, as long as their affairs are discovered by their Shangguan. Then their Shangguan will definitely do everything in their power to attack and oppress them.

Even encountering some ruthless people, they will directly kill them to avoid future troubles, and use this to warn other subordinates, so that they do not dare to have second thoughts.

And now, since this general is so loyal to himself, he has not concealed anything. Zhong Yu was naturally very relieved, and he couldn't help but feel relieved, and a trace of trust rose in his heart.

He opened his mouth to ask him a few other questions, and found that this person is relatively stable in his work, but he usually thinks about things very carefully.

Many things that people tend to overlook in the usual training work have been discovered by him very carefully and dealt with properly, and there have been no major mistakes.

This is a talent who tends to be conservative and stable, suitable for guarding one side of the city and protecting the peace of one side. His cautious thinking and character can enable him to minimize the threat in every place as much as possible, and eliminate possible rebellion to the greatest extent.

Looking at each of his own questions, he seemed to be well prepared, and he answered every question in an orderly manner.

This is not something ordinary people can do. If they don't spend enough time to understand and practice, ordinary people really can't do it.

His performance moved Zhong Yu, and he quietly had an idea just formed in Zhong Yu's heart. In the next period of time, the safety of the territory may be entrusted to this person.

But all of this is just an idea. If Zhong Yu really wants to put it into action, it depends on the performance of that person.

After inquiring again, the general was born and found that he is really not an ordinary person. His ancestor had a general, although he was only a colonel who commanded a thousand people.

But it can also be said that he was born in the general door, and there are some basic inheritance of the art of war. Since his ancestors, the descendants of the past dynasties have continued to learn the art of war, and they have all chosen the path of joining the army. Although there are no more generals with more than 1,000 people, there are some 100 generals and 50 generals.

With these constant inheritance, some small officers have appeared in the family. That man's father was also a general of fifty people, so when he was young, he was in the military camp with his father for a period of time, watching his father and his father's officers handle the affairs of the military camp. came up with a big concept of his own.

Therefore, when he was appointed by Zhong Yu as a general of a hundred people, he handled many affairs very skillfully. The 100 people under his command are among the four centenarian teams, and the training progress is the highest among them, which is why Zhong Yu chose him to answer his own questions.

This had to make Zhong Yu sigh in his heart, how profound the ancient families were compared to ordinary people. Let's not talk about the inheritance of knowledge, just these can be familiar with the daily affairs of various officials in advance. This kind of treatment is not something that ordinary people can enjoy, and only those second-generation officials and second-generation nobles can do it!
